decision: Do not promote the 96 drafts to training. Brightness fails the useful-label gate; other-color handling also needs correction. Preserve observed brightness separately from light/mid/dark retail color names.
limits: Eight observations sampled before inference, stratified by weak source-fit categories. Single rater and small sample; no population guarantee, independent held-out test or retrieval improvement claim. No unjudged labels are converted to zero.
